documents.title: Python palindrome program
documents.text: Here is a Python program to check if a string is a palindrome. def is_palindrome(s): return s == s[::-1]. A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. This code works for strings, numbers and lists. Use this function in your Python projects.

documents.title: Python palindrome code examples
documents.text: Python code for palindrome checking: number = int(input('Enter a number: ')); temp = number; reverse = 0; while number > 0: digit = number % 10; reverse = reverse * 10 + digit; number = number // 10; if temp == reverse: print('palindrome'). These are useful Python snippets for beginners learning algorithms.

documents.title: Python recursion tutorial
documents.text: Learn recursion in Python. A recursive function calls itself. Example: def factorial(n): return 1 if n <= 1 else n * factorial(n-1). Recursion is useful for tree traversal and divide-and-conquer.

documents.title: Python list comprehensions
documents.text: Python list comprehensions provide a concise way to create lists. squares = [x**2 for x in range(10)]. This is faster and more readable than for loops.

documents.title: Python requests library guide
documents.text: The Python requests library lets you send HTTP requests easily. import requests; r = requests.get('https://api.example.com'); print(r.json()). Handle status codes, headers, timeouts and sessions.

documents.title: What is artificial intelligence
documents.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the simulation of human intelligence by machines. AI includes machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing and computer vision. Modern AI systems use neural networks trained on large datasets.

documents.title: Machine learning algorithms explained
documents.text: Machine learning algorithms include linear regression, decision trees, random forests, support vector machines and neural networks. Supervised learning uses labeled data; unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data.

documents.title: Neural network basics
documents.text: A neural network consists of layers of interconnected nodes (neurons). Input layer receives data, hidden layers process it, output layer produces results. Backpropagation adjusts weights to minimize error.

documents.title: कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता क्या है
documents.text: कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (AI) मशीनों द्वारा मानव बुद्धि का अनुकरण है। इसमें मशीन लर्निंग, डीप लर्निंग, प्राकृतिक भाषा प्रसंस्करण और कंप्यूटर विज़न शामिल हैं। आधुनिक AI सिस्टम बड़े डेटासेट पर प्रशिक्षित न्यूरल नेटवर्क का उपयोग करते हैं।

documents.title: मशीन लर्निंग क्या है
documents.text: मशीन लर्निंग एक ऐसी तकनीक है जिसमें कंप्यूटर डेटा से सीखते हैं बिना स्पष्ट रूप से प्रोग्राम किए। वे पैटर्न की पहचान करते हैं और सुधार करते हैं। मशीन लर्निंग अल्गोरिदम में रिग्रेशन, क्लासिफिकेशन और क्लस्टरिंग शामिल हैं।

documents.title: डीप लर्निंग ट्यूटोरियल
documents.text: डीप लर्निंग मशीन लर्निंग का एक उपसमूह है जो न्यूरल नेटवर्क का उपयोग करता है। यह छवि पहचान, भाषा अनुवाद और खेल जैसे कार्यों में उत्कृष्ट है। कनवोल्यूशनल नेटवर्क छवियों के लिए उपयुक्त हैं।

documents.title: કૃત્રિમ બુદ્ધિ શું છે
documents.text: કૃત્રિમ બુદ્ધિ એ મશીનો દ્વારા માનવ બુદ્ધિનું અનુકરણ છે. તેમાં મશીન લર્નિંગ, ડીપ લર્નિંગ, કુદરતી ભાષા પ્રક્રિયા અને કમ્પ્યુટર વિઝનનો સમાવેશ થાય છે. આધુનિક AI સિસ્ટમ્સ મોટા ડેટાસેટ પર તાલીમ પામેલા ન્યૂરલ નેટવર્કનો ઉપયોગ કરે છે.

documents.title: મશીન લર્નિંગ ગુજરાતીમાં
documents.text: મશીન લર્નિંગ એ એક તકનીક છે જેમાં કમ્પ્યુટર ડેટા પરથી શીખે છે સ્પષ્ટ રીતે પ્રોગ્રામ કર્યા વિના. તેઓ પેટર્ન ઓળખે છે અને સુધારે છે. મશીન લર્નિંગ અલ્ગોરિધમમાં રિગ્રેશન, ક્લાસિફિકેશન અને ક્લસ્ટરિંગનો સમાવેશ થાય છે.

documents.title: ગુજરાતીમાં કૃત્રિમ બુદ્ધિ સમજાવો
documents.text: કૃત્રિમ બુદ્ધિ એ એવી તકનીક છે જેમાં મશીન માનવની જેમ વિચારવા અને નિર્ણય લેવાનું શીખે છે. AI ના ઉદાહરણોમાં વોચ રિકગ્નિશન, સELF-DRIVING કાર, અને ચેટબોટનો સમાવેશ થાય છે. મશીન લર્નિંગ અને ડીપ લર્નિંગ AI ના ભાગ છે.

documents.title: What is the capital of France
documents.text: The capital of France is Paris. Paris is located on the Seine River and is the largest city in France. It is known for the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum and Notre-Dame Cathedral.

documents.title: Who wrote Romeo and Juliet
documents.text: Romeo and Juliet was written by William Shakespeare. It is a tragedy about two young lovers whose deaths reconcile their feuding families. Written around 1594-1596.

documents.title: Photosynthesis process
documents.text: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize food from carbon dioxide and water. It produces oxygen and glucose. The equation is: 6CO2 + 6H2O + light -> C6H12O6 + 6O2.

documents.title: Water cycle explanation
documents.text: The water cycle describes the continuous movement of water on Earth. Steps: evaporation, condensation, precipitation, collection. The sun drives the cycle by heating water in oceans.

documents.title: Python vs JavaScript comparison
documents.text: Python and JavaScript are both popular programming languages. Python is used for data science, AI and backend. JavaScript is used for web development. Python uses indentation; JavaScript uses curly braces. Python is dynamically typed; JavaScript is also dynamically typed.

documents.title: React vs Angular
documents.text: React is a library by Facebook; Angular is a framework by Google. React uses virtual DOM; Angular uses real DOM with change detection. React is more flexible; Angular is opinionated. Both are used for building web applications.

documents.title: Weather in Mumbai
documents.text: Mumbai has a tropical wet and dry climate. Monsoon season is June to September. Average temperature ranges from 25C to 35C. Humidity is high throughout the year.

documents.title: What causes diabetes
documents.text: Diabetes is caused by insufficient insulin production or insulin resistance. Type 1 is autoimmune; Type 2 is lifestyle-related. Symptoms include frequent urination, excessive thirst and fatigue.

documents.title: Common cold remedies
documents.text: Common cold remedies include rest, fluids, honey, ginger tea and over-the-counter medications. The common cold is caused by viruses and usually resolves in 7-10 days.

documents.title: Stock market basics
documents.text: The stock market is where shares of public companies are bought and sold. Investors buy stocks to earn returns through dividends and capital appreciation. Major indices include S&P 500, Dow Jones and NASDAQ.

documents.title: Mutual funds explained
documents.text: A mutual fund pools money from many investors to invest in stocks, bonds and other assets. Professional fund managers make investment decisions. Mutual funds offer diversification and professional management.

documents.title: Best places to visit in India
documents.text: Popular tourist destinations in India include the Taj Mahal, Goa beaches, Kerala backwaters, Himalayan hill stations, Rajasthan forts and Delhi monuments. India offers diverse cultures and landscapes.

documents.text: To get a passport, submit an application online or at a passport office. Required documents include proof of identity, address and birth certificate. Processing time varies by country.

documents.text: Masala dosa is a South Indian dish. Ingredients: rice, urad dal, potatoes, spices. Soak and grind rice and dal, ferment overnight. Make potato masala with mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric. Spread batter on tava, add masala, fold and serve with chutney.

documents.text: Chess is a two-player strategy board game. Each player starts with 16 pieces: king, queen, rooks, bishops, knights and pawns. The goal is to checkmate the opponent's king.

documents.title: Cricket World Cup winners
documents.text: The Cricket World Cup is held every four years. Winners include Australia (6 times), India (2 times), West Indies (2 times), Pakistan, Sri Lanka and England. The 2023 World Cup was won by Australia.

documents.title: Olympic games history
documents.text: The modern Olympic Games began in 1896 in Athens. Held every four years, the Olympics feature summer and winter sports. The 2024 Olympics were held in Paris. The 2028 Olympics will be in Los Angeles.

documents.title: What is cloud computing
documents.text: Cloud computing delivers computing services over the internet. Services include servers, storage, databases, networking and AI. Major providers are AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. Benefits include scalability and cost savings.

documents.title: Blockchain technology explained
documents.text: Blockchain is a distributed ledger technology. Blocks contain transaction data and are linked cryptographically. It is decentralized and immutable. Used in cryptocurrencies and supply chain management.

documents.title: Software engineer interview questions
documents.text: Common software engineer interview questions include data structures, algorithms, system design and behavioral questions. Practice coding problems on LeetCode and HackerRank. Be prepared to discuss your projects.

documents.title: How to write a resume
documents.text: A good resume includes contact info, summary, work experience, skills and education. Use action verbs and quantify achievements. Keep it to one page for early career. Tailor to each job application.
